method: Closed native red ISIE path, EPSG:32632 from embedded PDF control points; one app-grid unit preservation margin, one-sided clip of OSM Boumerdes by installed ISIE Ghnada.
uncertainty: Paired ISIE 2023 maps draw the Monastir/Mahdia governorate line between Ghnada and Boumerdes. Remove only the unsupported portion of the installed OSM Boumerdes/Ghnada overlap, preserving the small overlap also present in Boumerdes' closed native red source ring. The native ring is a geographic guide, not a complete replacement: using it alone creates substantial overlaps with other OSM neighbors. The remaining seam and ground accuracy are unverified.
